question.text: Which of the following correctly describes the SCORES system used by SEBI?

answer.text: A physical complaint filing system at SEBI regional offices
A rating system for evaluating merchant banker performance
A system for scoring and ranking IPO applications
A centralized web-based complaint redress system requiring daily login by merchant bankers

explanation.text: The Logic: SCORES is a centralised web-based complaints redress system maintained by SEBI. It enables online movement and upload of Action Taken Reports (ATRs), and merchant bankers are expected to log in daily to monitor and address complaints. The Trap: The name SCORES might suggest a rating or scoring mechanism, but it stands for SEBI Complaints Redress System; the daily-login requirement is the distinguishing feature for merchant bankers. Note: The defining features are the centralised web-based platform, online ATR movement, and the daily-login expectation.
